text: 医药股涨幅居前，康希诺生物涨约14%，中国生物制药涨约4%。地产股上涨，世茂集团涨约13%，富力地产涨约9%。科技股、大模型股上涨，智谱涨约8%，MINIMAX涨约2%；百度集团涨约3%，阿里巴巴涨约3%。
text_en: Pharmaceutical stocks led the gains, with CanSino Biologics up about 14% and Sino Biopharmaceutical up about 4%. Property stocks rose, with Shimao Group up about 13% and R&F Properties up about 9%. Technology stocks and large-model stocks rose, with Zhipu up about 8% and MINIMAX up about 2%; Baidu Group up about 3% and Alibaba up about 3%.
